title: Russian Salad
description: Russian Salad is a classic Continental salad made with tender vegetables, a creamy mayonnaise dressing, and optional chicken for added richness. Chilled before serving, it is a refreshing appetizer or side dish with a smooth, creamy texture and vibrant colors.

ingredients.title: For the Protein (Optional)
items: Cooked chicken breast, finely diced – 100 g
Ham, turkey, or crab meat – optional substitute

ingredients.title: For the Dressing
items: Mayonnaise (preferably homemade or high-quality store-bought) – 1/2 cup

instruction.title: Step 1 – Cook the Vegetables
steps: Boil potatoes and carrots separately until just tender (al dente), about 8–10 minutes.
Boil peas and corn for 2–3 minutes.
Drain and cool all vegetables immediately in ice water to retain color and texture.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Dressing
steps: In a bowl, mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, white pepper, and sugar.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Combine the Ingredients
steps: In a large bowl, gently toss the cooled vegetables and protein with the dressing.
Avoid overmixing; maintain the shape and texture of the vegetables.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Chill
steps: Cover and refrigerate for at least 1–2 hours.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating
steps: Use a ring mold to shape the salad on a plate.
Garnish with parsley, microgreens, and pomegranate seeds.
Drizzle a tiny bit of high-quality olive oil around the plate for extra flair.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as an appetizer or side dish.
Pair with grilled meats, roasted chicken, or seafood.
Garnish with fresh parsley, microgreens, or pomegranate seeds for an elegant presentation.

chefTips: Homemade mayonnaise gives a fresh, silky texture.
Cut vegetables into uniform 0.5–1 cm cubes for a professional presentation.
Do not overcook the vegetables to maintain a slight crunch.
Top with smoked salmon or caviar for an ultra-fine dining variation.
Chill the salad for at least 1–2 hours before serving for the best flavor.
